Given a dialogue context and a candidate response, we instruct the model to predict "yes" if the response is relevant to the context, otherwise predict "no". We calculate the probability of "yes" as p(yes) = p(yes)/(p(yes) + p(no)). We calculate the Spearman correlation of the model's prediction with human ratings for relevance provided in the DSTC-10 test sets
